subject: Remittance XML upload failed — remote sweep not applied
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@brightbyte.com>
To: camila.reyes@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 05 May 2027 09:15:00 +0000
Subject: Remittance file uploaded but remote sweep did not apply

Hi Camila,

We pushed our remittance XML for yesterday's payment run (file attached) into the virtual account portal, but our accounting team shows the funds were swept and not allocated to any invoices. The portal returned a 202 Accepted but the sweep marker on our side shows 'APPLIED:NO' and several invoices remain open.

Attached: remittance_20270504.xml and a screenshot of the portal response (screenshot-upload-error.png). Can you confirm receipt and whether the XML schema changed? We reconciled against last month's template and it looks identical.

Impact: ~€112,450 of invoices remain unapplied; payment clearing date 2027-05-04. We need the allocation evidence for our auditors and to avoid dunning.

Please advise next steps and whether you need a bank trace.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Finance — BrightByte Technologies
elena.ruiz@brightbyte.com

---
Attachment: remittance_20270504.xml (application/xml, 14KB)
Attachment: screenshot-upload-error.png (image/png, 120KB)

From: camila.reyes@redwood.com <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@brightbyte.com>
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 05 May 2027 09:42:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Remittance file uploaded but remote sweep did not apply

Hi Elena — thanks for the heads-up and the attachments. 

Quick summary of next steps from our side:
- I confirmed the remittance payload was accepted by our ingestion queue (202). It looks like the sweep executed but the allocation step failed due to a mismatch on the currency tag for a subset of lines (EUR vs EUR ').
- Vanessa, can your ops team pull the application logs for the 20270504 sweep window (03:00–05:00 UTC) and extract the allocation error lines?
- Elena, could you send a short sample row from your ERP export (one of the unapplied invoice numbers and the corresponding payment reference) so we can match string tokens?

For immediate remediation, we can:
1) Run a targeted allocation replay for the unapplied payments once we correct the payload tokens (low risk).
2) If replay can't match, we will provide a bank-level trace for the mate of the sweep and apply manually.

I expect we can have a confirmation or a follow-up by EOD today. Apologies for the disruption — we want to make this painless for your audit window.

Camila Reyes
Senior Account Finance Manager
Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0194

---
Attachment: remittance_20270504.xml (forwarded copy)

From: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: camila.reyes@redwood.com, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@brightbyte.com>
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 05 May 2027 10:10:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Remittance file uploaded but remote sweep did not apply

Thanks Camila & Elena — pulled logs for the sweep window.

Findings (summary):
- Ingestion: remittance_20270504.xml accepted at 03:22:11 UTC.
- Allocation worker threw parsing warnings for 18 line-items where the <Currency> tag contained trailing whitespace characters. These went into the 'needs_manual_review' queue instead of the automated allocation path.
- No funds were lost — the sweep cleared to our holding account; only the mapping to invoice IDs failed.

Immediate actions taken:
- I exported the list of affected payment references and uploaded to the shared Drive folder (link above).
- Triggering an allocation replay now that we've normalized the currency tags. Replay ETA: ~90 minutes.

If replay succeeds, we will send a remittance confirmation (PDF) with invoice-level allocations. If it fails, we will request a bank trace and apply allocations manually.

Jonas, please stand by to coordinate manual applies if the replay hits unresolvable token differences.

Vanessa Ortiz
Finance Operations Lead, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com

Attachment: allocation_errors_20270504.csv (generated log extract)

Camila / Vanessa — thank you both for the quick investigation and the shared folder. I dropped a sample ERP row into the Drive (file: sample_row.csv) and the accounting team confirms the 18 references listed match our unapplied items.

Please proceed with the allocation replay. If you need any CSV transforms from our side, say the column order and we'll send immediately. We appreciate the ETA — auditors asked for allocation evidence by COB.

Best,
Elena
